features.name: Synth
features.description: Play synth sounds from the pads and edit their parameters.
features.evidence: P6S has owner-confirmed playing, EXIT, repeat entry and a short USB screen/audio take. Recording to a pad remains disabled. Later full-engine work has separate offline evidence.
features.blocker: A selectable Synth build and configurable shortcut dispatcher have not been qualified.

footprint.scope: Historical P6S module only; not an additive composition budget.

features.name: USB screen, controls & audio recorder
features.description: Record an SP session on your computer, including screens, control changes and USB audio.
features.evidence: The SPG1 v5.52 component passes 125 Cortex-M7 groups. Native screen packing and control delivery execute with supplied service boundaries. Global physical recording and audio/video timing remain unqualified.
features.blocker: The global stream needs a complete firmware join and physical screen/control/audio verification.

footprint.scope: Alternative global stream owner; replaces historical stream objects and cannot be added to their size.

features.name: Stem splitting
features.evidence: No qualified device package or memory budget is registered for this feature yet.
features.blocker: The stem-splitting provider, firmware adapter and resource budget have not been registered.

features.name: Autotune
features.description: Correct or shift the pitch of a monophonic input.
features.evidence: T2P is packaged with 22 CPU groups and two stock PCM checks. It has no physical listening result and does not include the full Input FX, key/scale interface or formant processor.
features.blocker: The listening candidate and a shared Synth/Autotune entry must be qualified before selectable installation.

footprint.scope: T2P prototype including inherited P6S owners; not an additive composition budget.
